name: The Power Plant Contemporary Art Gallery
funding: Registered charity The Art Gallery at Harbourfront. Canada Council, Ontario Arts Council and Toronto Arts Council; BMO Financial Group sponsors free admission.

name: YYZ Artists' Outlet
funding: The Ontario Arts Council funds its exhibitions through an Exhibition Assistance grant.

name: Contemporary Art Gallery (CAG)
funding: Canada Council, BC Arts Council, BC Gaming Policy and Enforcement Branch, City of Vancouver and Connor, Clark and Lunn Investment Management.

name: Western Front
funding: 2025-26: Canada Council, BC Arts Council, Province of BC and City of Vancouver, with the Audain Foundation and Western Front Foundation at $20k+.

name: grunt gallery
funding: Canada Council for the Arts, British Columbia Arts Council, City of Vancouver, Province of British Columbia and Audain Foundation for the Visual Arts.

name: Art Gallery of Greater Victoria
funding: Revenue c. CAD 6.1M in 2025 (charity filing via Wikidata); BC, City of Victoria, members, AGGV Foundation endowment.

name: Audain Art Museum
funding: Audain Foundation and Polygon Homes. Endowment founders include Onni Group, Whistler Blackcomb Foundation and the Resort Municipality of Whistler. The April 2026 gala raised C$1.5M.

name: Plug In ICA
funding: Canada Council, Manitoba Arts Council, Winnipeg Arts Council and the federal government. Corporate supporters: RBC Foundation and Johnston Group, a benefits firm.

name: Urban Shaman Contemporary Aboriginal Art
funding: Small artist-run centre. Canada Council gave $280k over two years (2017-18). Also Manitoba Arts Council, Winnipeg Arts Council and Province of Manitoba.

name: Winnipeg Art Gallery-Qaumajuq
funding: 2024 donor list: Canada, Manitoba, City of Winnipeg, Nunavut; TD Bank Group ($100-249k), Canada Life, Power Corporation, RBC, Manitoba Liquor & Lotteries, Richardson, Asper Foundation.

name: Bienal de Artes Mediales de Santiago
funding: Chile's Ministry of Cultures, through its collaborating-organisations programme and audiovisual fund, plus donations under the Cultural Donations Law. 2025 partners: SURA, Nescafé, La Tercera, Radio 13c.
